# Epigram

> Epigram is an open-source, AI-powered news reader that delivers short, topic-organized summaries of stories from trusted sources. (Placeholder content.)

This is dummy content for llms-full.txt. Replace it with the real project documentation.

## Overview

Epigram fetches news stories, summarizes them with AI, and presents them in a fast, swipeable, responsive reading feed. Users can browse by topic and open a deeper AI analysis of any article.

## Pages

- [Home](https://epigram.news/): Personalized news feed
- [Topics](https://epigram.news/topics): Browse news by topic
- [About](https://epigram.news/about): About the project

## Features

- Personalized news feed based on selected topics
- AI-generated summaries and deep-dive analysis
- Responsive design with add-to-home-screen support

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion
- Vercel AI SDK with OpenAI
- Upstash Redis for caching
- Mediastack and Exa for news sources
